source.name: FreightPOP for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central

mapping.summary: Links BC to FreightPOP for multi-carrier rate shopping, labels, tracking and freight audit.
claims: Rate shopping, booking and tracking across carriers
Covers parcel, LTL, FTL, ocean, rail and international air
Integrates with LTL carriers, brokers, forwarders and parcel carriers such as FedEx, UPS, USPS and DHL
Produces labels, return labels, bills of lading, packing slips and commercial invoices
Rules automate tendering from order to carrier
Inbound tracking including live ocean containers
AI agents for load planning, accessorial detection, invoice audit, documents and pickups
Pulls posted sales shipments from BC every 10 minutes, or on demand
Imported shipments include address, item, quantity, price, cost, weight and shipping agent
Writes shipping agent, service and tracking number back to the posted shipment
Suggests accessorial charges like liftgate or residential delivery when creating shipments
AI copilot answers freight audit questions in plain language
MCP server lets AI assistants quote, book and track freight
Connects through BC web services with Entra ID token authentication
Aimed at companies shipping 100+ shipments a month across carriers
